Subject ASSISTANCE TO JAPANESE MILITARY POLICE.

Made by D.S.I. PRYDE    Forwarded by D. I. HLOVER.

Sir,

    At 2.30 p.m. 18.7.38 Sgt. Major Marita of the Japanese
Military Police requested assistance to search the home of
a Chinese prisoner named Tseu Wei Wo, who had been arrested
in Chapei for anti-Japanese activities.

    Assistance was rendered by D.S.I.s Pryde and Soong
Ping Sung of C.B.H.Q.(C.l), D.C.s Yamahara and Sameshima
of the S.P.O. and D.I. Boddy of Sinza Station. The prisoner
then led this party to 1534 Sinza Road which proved to be
in B'Well Dist. A room on the 1st floor which was previous-
ly occupied by this prisoner was searched, and two letters
seized. Translations attached.

    B'Well Station was notified immediately after the
search had taken place.

（左侧边缘手写批注：）

                                Yours obediently,

                              总部中央捕房    分局编号 8299/20
报告                          日期 1938年8月19日

事由：协助日本宪兵队。

由副督察长普赖德（Pryde）呈报    经督察长赫洛弗（Hlover）转呈

先生：

    1938年7月18日下午2时30分，日本宪兵队军曹长马利塔（Marita）请求协助搜查一名名为周伟沃（Tseu Wei Wo，音译）的中国囚犯的住所，该囚犯因从事反日活动在闸北被捕。

    中央捕房总部（刑事组）副督察长普赖德（Pryde）和宋平松（Soong Ping Sung，音译）、特别股警探山原（Yamahara，音译）和鮫岛（Sameshima，音译），以及新闸路分局督察长博迪（Boddy）提供了协助。随后，该囚犯带领上述人员前往新闸路1534号，该址经查实位于百老汇路巡捕房辖区。警方搜查了该囚犯此前居住的一楼房间，并查获两封信件。译文附后。

    搜查结束后，立即通知了百老汇路巡捕房。

（左侧边缘手写批注：）

Subject    TRANSLATION OF THE DRAFT OF A LETTER.

Made by____________________Forwarded by____________________

To the Japanese Gendarmerie in Shanghai :

    The undersigned, Tseu Yueh Sai, begs to ask for
a thorough investigation on behalf of my son, Tseu Ming Woo :-
    Tseu Ming Woo, aged 30 years, native of Zien Jao
Village, Wusieh, received his education at a primary school
during his early years. He came to Shanghai at the age of 17
and became employed as a "boy" by a foreigner who lived in a
white building. When he was 21 years old, he obtained a job
as a "boy" at the Blue Bird Cabaret, North Szechuen Road,
through the introduction of one of my friends. He has been
employed in this position for about 9 years and during his
employment he was liked by both the master and mistress and
eventually promoted to a higher position. This, however,
incuried the jealousy of his fellow-workers, who invented
false stories against him in order to cause his dismissal from
this job.

    In view of the fact that my son supports a family
of seven, the undersigned earnestly requests that further
enquiries be made into this case. The owner of the Blue Bird
Cabaret can prove the veracity of my statement.

致驻上海日本宪兵队：

    具状人周月赛（Tseu Yueh Sai，音译）谨代表吾儿周明武（Tseu Ming Woo，音译）恳请予以彻底调查：
    周明武，现年30岁，籍贯吴县（Wusieh）仙桥村（Zien Jao Village，音译）。幼年时在小学接受教育。17岁时来到上海，受雇于一位居住在白色楼房内的外国人，担任“侍童”（boy）。21岁时，经我一位朋友介绍，他在北四川路的蓝鸟舞厅（Blue Bird Cabaret）谋得一份“侍童”的工作。他在此职位上工作了约9年，任职期间深受主人和主母喜爱，并最终获得晋升。然而，这引起了同事的嫉妒，他们编造虚假故事诬陷他，企图导致他被解雇。

    鉴于吾儿需供养一家七口，具状人恳请对此案进行进一步调查。蓝鸟舞厅的老板可证明我所言属实。

2nd Lieut. Yoshida stated that the enquiries regarding
these men were conducted by the Japanese Military
Intelligence Department which obtained assistance from
S.M.P. Headquarters recently and searched Room 711
and 717 of the Yangtse Hotel where they admitted
having recently lived.

Between 2.30a.m. and 3a.m. on the 3/3/38, whilst
the guard was temporarily absent from the detention
room, the two prisoners, both handcuffed, climbed out
from the man-hole of the detention room, onto the dock
and thence jumped into a small boat which was secured
to the Floating Restaurant. From this boat they
escaped onto Peking Road Jetty and into the Settlement
Road.

The message was circulated immediately by tele-
printer to all stations and French Police.

It should be mentioned that at 5.15a.m. on the
3/3/38 P.S. 548 Duffy reported to the station that a
pair of handcuffs had been found on the footpath outside
No.170 Nanking Road, whilst he was patrolling. As this
pair of handcuffs appears to be Japanese make, it was
shown to Mr. Yoshida who identified them as the type
used by the Japanese Military Police. Further enquiries

涉嫌为中国流动小组（Chinese Mobile Unit）成员。
吉田（Yoshida）中尉称，对这些人的调查由日本军事情报部门进行，该部门近期获得了上海公共租界警务处总部的协助，并搜查了扬子饭店（Yangtse Hotel）的711和717房间，这些人承认最近曾居住于此。

1938年3月3日凌晨2时30分至3时之间，趁拘留室看守暂时离开之际，两名戴着手铐的囚犯从拘留室的下水道井盖爬出，登上码头，随即跳上一艘系泊在浮动餐厅旁的小船。他们乘此船逃至北京路码头，并进入租界道路区域。

该消息立即通过电传打字机通报给所有分局及法国警察。

需提及的是，1938年3月3日凌晨5时15分，警员548号达菲（Duffy）向分局报告，他在巡逻时于南京路170号外的人行道上发现了一副手铐。由于这副手铐看似日本制造，便出示给吉田先生查看，他确认这是日本宪兵队使用的类型。进一步查询

page_data.en:
Misc.No.790/38.
1/sheet 3.

were made by him at his office and it was ascertained
that the number on these handcuffs is the same as that
of the handcuffs which the escaped prisoner, Po Haf
Ming had been wearing. Careful examination revealed
that no force had been applied to the handcuffs and it
appeared that the prisoner had slipped his hands through
the link and thus freed himself.

This handcuff will be returned to the Japanese
Military Police against signature in the detained
property book.

From enquiries it appears that the prisoners
proceeded towards Foochow Road from the Bund and one of
them succeeded in freeing his hands in the vicinity of
No.170 Foochow Road. Therefore C.D.S. 48 was instructed
to make enquiries at all garages in the surrounding
vicinity to check up on persons who had hired a m/car
at this time.

In the conclusion of this report C.D.S. 48 reports
having made enquiries at The Silver Taxi 139 Szechuen
Road, Fuhock Garage 506 Nanking Road, Best Garage
No. 60 Avenue Edward VII, but no information which would
assist the Police in tracing the prisoners could be
obtained.

〔此处转录不清〕

由他在其办公室进行，经查实，这些手铐上的编号与逃犯波哈明（Po Haf Ming，音译）所佩戴的手铐编号相同。仔细检查显示，手铐未受到外力破坏，看来是囚犯将手从链环中滑出从而挣脱。

这副手铐将在扣押物品登记簿上签字后归还给日本宪兵队。

经查询，囚犯似乎从外滩向福州路方向行进，其中一人在福州路170号附近成功挣脱双手。因此，指令刑事侦缉股第48组（C.D.S. 48）对周边地区的所有汽车行进行调查，核对该时段租赁机动车的人员。

在本报告结尾，刑事侦缉股第48组报告称，已对四川路139号的银星出租车行（The Silver Taxi）、南京路506号的福霍克车库（Fuhock Garage，音译）以及爱德华七世大道60号的最佳车库（Best Garage）进行了查询，但未能获得有助于警方追踪囚犯的任何信息。

〔此处转录不清〕
